directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel 120 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³. Outlet Pressure 40 MPa. Main Unit Weight 8000 kg. Theoretical Output 100 m³/h. Aggregate Size 6 cm and below. The printed output cell is 100 m³/h. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112 (two units). Dimensions (L×W×H) 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. The published cells are: Model Diesel 120. Copy only the printed cells: Model Diesel 120. Engine Power (Diesel) 290 kW (two units 145 kW). The printed power cell is 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Put /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump in the subject. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 6 cm and below. The printed distance row or rows: Conveying Distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and Main Unit Weight is 8000 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. Theoretical Output is 100 m³/h OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. The section title “Daltons Law of Partial Pressure” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是柴油120型混凝土泵输送量与输送距离询盘的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。料斗容积 0.6 m³.整机重量 8000 kg。最大出口压力 40 MPa.理论输送量 100 m³/h.已印输送量是 100 m³/h。只抄已印格子：型号 Diesel 120.已公布的格子是：型号 Diesel 120.最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below.已印骨料或粒径是 6 cm and below。外形尺寸 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm.液压泵 Kawasaki 112 (two units).柴油机功率 290 kW (two units 145 kW).已印动力是 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m。主题里写上 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。运输请抄外形尺寸是 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm，整机重量是 8000 kg。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油120型混凝土泵列在 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。理论输送量是 100 m³/h OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump 开始。节标题「Daltons Law的局部 压力」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump.

question.en: Does “Daltons Law of Partial Pressure” replace Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³?
question.zh: 「Daltons Law的局部 压力」会替换「料斗容积 0.6 m³」吗？

answer.en: No. Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³ remains the printed wording for Diesel 120 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。料斗容积 0.6 m³仍是柴油120型混凝土泵输送量与输送距离询盘已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Outlet Pressure 40 MPa belong on the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵输送量与输送距离询盘这一行里，「整机重量 8000 kg。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “The Partial Pressure in a Mixture” add to Diesel 120 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「局部 压力 在 混合物」给柴油120型混凝土泵输送量与输送距离询盘增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steam-air-mixture-d_427.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steam-air-mixture-d_427.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
